decisions.body:
Decision: option A, in the shape of design D1.

Verified your report against the code: resolveReadOnly/boardReader go through
TrackerAdapterFactory.create (TrackerWiring.java:142-158), the GitHub create
always runs GithubLabelProvisioner.provision (GithubTrackerAdapterFactory.java:123-124),
and provision lists then POSTs (GithubLabelProvisioner.java:58-81). One premise
is refuted: refuseForeignRef(SecretsProvider, TrackerConfig, TaskRef) already
is a read-only SPI default method with the credential seam, making one GET
through GithubForeignRepoCheck — so the SPI shape you proposed has a precedent,
and a default method is a compatible addition re-baselined under the japicmp
gate.

The change artifacts on this branch are already amended (uncommitted in the
worktree; commit them with your next round): design D3 now points to a new D7,
proposal gains an ADDED bullet, a sharper FR3, NG5 and the github-tracker
modified capability; the operator-doctor delta has the revised scenario
"Online adds a read-only tracker probe" plus a new "Online probe refused";
a new delta specs/tracker/github-tracker MODIFIES "Idempotent label
provisioning as startup smoke test" with the scenario "Read probe lists and
writes nothing"; task 3.3 is split into 3.3a-3.3c. Read D7 and the three tasks
first; the essentials:

1. 3.3a (:adapters:github): GithubLabelProvisioner.assess(owner, repo, labelDefs)
   makes the listing GET alone and returns a verdict — readable with the missing
   label names, or refused with the HTTP class and the cause the current message
   names (404 worded "not found or not visible to this token"; on 403 the
   X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions header verbatim). provision = assess, create
   the missing labels, refuse on a failed verdict, same exception and message.
   GithubLabelProvisionerSpec: provision refuses exactly when assess fails, over
   one data table of statuses; assess sends no POST.
2. 3.3b (:gnomish-plugin-api): default method
   TrackerAdapterFactory.probeRead(SecretsProvider, TrackerConfig) returning a
   probe verdict type of the api; the default makes no call and reports "not
   applicable" (the in-memory adapter keeps it); the GitHub override builds its
   client as refuseForeignRef does and returns assess. Regenerate the japicmp
   baseline in the same task.
3. 3.3c (:bootstrap): TrackerReadProbe over a TrackerWiring.probeRead relay
   (like refuseForeignRef), never create() or the read-only resolution. The line
   reports reading confirmed, the labels startup will create, and that write
   access is not verified (NG5: GitHub has no read-only way to evaluate a write).
   WireMock on a repository without the labels: exactly one GET and no POST with
   --online, no request without; plus the refused scenario (404 and 403).

Do not retry a 401 (GitHub locks the user out after repeated bad credentials);
the client already retries only 5xx/429/rate-limit, keep it so.

Task 5.4 is a human step: leave it unticked and note it in your report. Then
continue with 3.4 onward.
decisions.author: tracker

lastEscalation.question:
add-doctor-command, task 3.3 (TrackerReadProbe behind --online) cannot be built as the design states it. Tasks 1.1-3.2 are done, verified and ticked; 3.3 and everything after it is untouched.

What blocks it: design D3 says the probe uses "the tracker's existing read-only resolution". That resolution, TrackerWiring.resolveReadOnly / boardReader (application/src/main/java/com/github/oinsio/gnomish/app/TrackerWiring.java:142-158), builds the adapter through TrackerAdapterFactory.create. GithubTrackerAdapterFactory.create (adapters/github/.../GithubTrackerAdapterFactory.java:123-124) always runs GithubLabelProvisioner.provision first: it lists the labels, then POSTs every missing one (GithubLabelProvisioner.java:60, 75-81). So on a repository without the factory's labels, `gnomish doctor --online` would write to the tracker. That breaks NFR-R1 (no side effects) and the scenario "Online adds a read-only tracker probe". Even with the labels present it makes at least two requests, the label listing plus the probe read, while task 3.3 asks for exactly one read. No other operation of the TrackerAdapterFactory SPI reads without create(). The same shape already exists in board and dashboard, whose spec accepts the label creation; doctor's requirements forbid it.

Alternative zero (no probe): --online does nothing new. Offline doctor still reports whether the token is present, but not whether it can read the repository (U4). A bad token is still caught loudly by the label provisioning when take/serve start.

Options, ranked by failure class:
A (recommended) - an adapter-owned read-only probe on the SPI: a default method on TrackerAdapterFactory (e.g. probeRead(secrets, trackerConfig)). The in-memory adapter's default makes no call. GitHub overrides it with exactly the label listing that provisioning starts with (GET /labels), extracted so both share one owner. TrackerWiring exposes it, so the credential seam stays there. That is one GET and no write, which meets FR3 and the scenario as written. Cost: it grows the published plugin API, and D3 plus task 3.3 must be amended through /architect Mode C and /opsx:update.
B - a read-only mode for create() that skips provisioning, with listReady(1) as the probe. Its weakness, first: it is 1-2 reads, not exactly one (a comments fetch per ready issue). It also changes board and dashboard behaviour and the tracker-board spec, and it changes the plugin API too.
C - use resolveReadOnly as written. Rejected: it writes labels and makes 2+ requests, so the scenario would have to be narrowed as a fix, which spec-mismatch.md forbids.

What I would do: A. Amend D3 and task 3.3 (touching :gnomish-plugin-api, :adapters:github and TrackerWiring), then build 3.3 and continue with 3.4-5.4. Note also: task 5.4 is a human step on the operator stand (break three things, run doctor once) that this unattended stage cannot perform.
options: A: add an adapter-owned read-only probe to the TrackerAdapterFactory SPI (GitHub = one GET /labels, shared with provisioning); amend D3 and task 3.3 accordingly, then continue
B: add a read-only mode to create() that skips label provisioning and probe with listReady(1); accept 1-2 reads and amend D3, 3.3 and the tracker-board spec
Drop the --online probe from this change (defer FR3 / U4 to a follow-up change with a named pickup condition) and continue with 3.4 onward
